title: SLS-Bench: A Benchmark for Incident Log Summarization with Synthetic Observability Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.16412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As IT systems grow in complexity, automated agent-driven incident response becomes increasingly critical. A key capability for these agents is summarizing large log streams into human-readable reports. Further progress requires meaningfully evaluating this function, yet existing benchmarks leave end-to-end summarization from large log streams underexplored due to the prohibitive cost and complexity of collecting real-world data. We introduce SLS-Bench, a benchmark for incident log summarization featuring 90 tasks grounded in real-world incident reports, each with a synthetic log stream and a reference summary. To construct SLS-Bench, we developed a data generation pipeline that converts incident reports into structured incident models, which guide the generation of synthetic logs and reference summaries. translated_title: SLS-Bench：一个基于合成可观测性数据的事件日志摘要基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着IT系统日益复杂，基于自动化代理的事件响应变得越来越关键。这些代理的一项核心能力是将海量日志流总结为人类可读的报告。要取得进一步进展，需要对这一功能进行有意义的评估，然而由于收集真实世界数据的成本和复杂性过高，现有基准测试对从大型日志流进行端到端摘要的评估仍然不足。我们提出了SLS-Bench，这是一个事件日志摘要基准测试，包含90个基于真实世界事件报告的任务，每个任务都配有合成日志流和参考摘要。为构建SLS-Bench，我们开发了一个数据生成流水线，将事件报告转换为结构化的事件模型，再由这些模型指导合成日志和参考摘要的生成。该流水线结合了叙述性依据、显式事件建模、生成器-验证器循环以及与真实数据的统计比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了SLS-Bench，一个包含90个基于真实事件报告的任务的事件日志摘要基准测试，通过将事件报告转化为结构化事件模型来生成合成日志流和参考摘要，解决了收集真实世界数据成本过高的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SLS-Bench, a benchmark for incident log summarization with 90 tasks grounded in real-world incident reports, which converts incident reports into structured incident models to generate synthetic log streams and reference summaries, overcoming the prohibitive cost of collecting real-world data.
